name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.186.0 — Every mock has a page you can mark (specs/20260913/06): every atlas card — journey-owned mock, unclaimed mock, or shape — now links to its own screen page at /screen/<label>.html (lib/review-page.js's new buildScreenPage, built from the review page's own board/inspector parts, with no journey rail and no approve control); the lightbox, __full, and every open ↗ link (client- and server-rendered) are deleted outright, and the project panel's jump pill links straight to a drawn screen's page instead of gating on the lightbox. ADR-0027 narrows specs/20260912/05 D4 and specs/20260905/01 D3. 7.185.0 — Merging a spec worktree now commits the run-log rows and retained evidence it copies onto main (chore(ledger): record <spec> build and review rows), limited to those two paths and skipped when they are git-ignored or unchanged. Before this, those copied files stayed uncommitted and the next spec's merge refused with "root working tree is dirty" (hit twice on 2026-09-14). 7.184.0 — A note is a conversation: turnOf(n) in lib/mocks-notes.js is the one derivation of whose turn it is (session/you/done/dropped) off status/resolution/addressed/reply, replacing four separate per-surface colour rules; the owner may reply on the page as often as they like (POST /__notes/reopen now refuses only a resolved note), the CLI's now-redundant reply subcommand and its writer are deleted in favor of one session verb (notes address), and POST /__notes/resolve requires an explicit verdict so Approve and Reject write different records — Reject is final and hidden from every page. notes open now lists only what waits on the session. ADR-0026 narrows specs/20260912/12 D17, specs/20260902/10 D4 and specs/20260912/06's row controls.
